# Fixtures of the page math pass tests

- `elementary-algebra-5-2-p12.pdf`: one page of *Elementary Algebra* (OpenStax), section 5.2,
  CC BY 4.0, https://openstax.org (retired first edition), printed to PDF by
  `eval render` as the development set's input; `.answer.json` is the page math pass's
  recorded answer for it.
- `latex-matrices-p2.pdf`: page 2 of the authored LaTeX matrices document of
  `data/dev-v2/authored` (MIT, this project); `.answer.json` likewise.

Both come from the development set; none is from the held-out set.
